verdict.rationale: Qualcomm publishes a headline NPU TOPS figure (85 TOPS) and ships developer tooling today (AI Engine Direct SDK, Qualcomm AI Hub, GenieX runtime) that targets the Hexagon NPU, satisfying most of the story. However the TOPS figure has no stated precision, and the chip itself won't ship in PCs until 2026, meaning developers can't yet target real X2 Elite Extreme silicon. Missing for 10: precision spec for the 85 TOPS figure, evidence of SDK support specifically validated on X2 Elite Extreme hardware, independent benchmark corroboration.
